column3: State do-not-call registries (Indiana, Texas, Colorado, Pennsylvania, Missouri) missing from the pre-dial gate
column4: Add a state_dnc_registry row for each state that runs a list (IN, TX, CO, PA, MO and others). Each row carries its own exemption predicate and is never mapped to federal PEWC. Scrub against every candidate jurisdiction's list before each dial, and do not dial when a list is stale or unavailable or its exemption can't be proven. Add a model-checked invariant: no DIAL edge unless every candidate state's registry check passes.
column5: Track each state list's download date and the refresh cadence its statute requires as a certificate input. A stale list then decertifies dialing in that state.

column3: Consent revoked through another channel (STOP reply to the e-sign SMS, email, installer, website) never reaching the dialer
column4: Build a revocation intake bus. The e-sign vendor, SMS short codes, email, the web form, installers and CRM notes all feed the stop lexicon plus the GLOBAL stop classifier. A hit writes the DNC ledger within 1 business day, unmatched replies go to human review, the ledger is read at every dial (scheduled callbacks included), and vendor contracts require replies and STOP events to be forwarded. Add Tier A fault-injection tests for each channel.
column5: Treat a STOP keyword on any short code as global revocation for every campaign tied to that number.

column3: TSR 310.5 five-year recordkeeping vs "no-retain mode" and combinatorial fragment wordings
column5: Set an explicit retention schedule: CDRs, consent artifacts, render logs and every fragment wording kept 5 or more years in WORM storage regardless of privacy mode, with NO_RETAIN defined in writing as covering caller content only.

column3: Litigation hold triggered mid-call ("my lawyer is recording this") while automated deletion keeps running
column4: Add a legal_threat GLOBAL event, fired by a lexicon or by Needle. It plays a fixed neutral fragment, offers a human, ends the pitch and sets legal_hold. The hold freezes every deletion, surrogate and scrub job for that session and number, keeps the original audio and transcript, and alerts legal. Inbound complaint and demand channels and the post-call sweep set the same hold. Add Tier A tests of hold versus deletion.

column3: Illinois BIPA: speaker-change detection, self-echo filtering and prosody features as voiceprint collection without a written release
column5: Add a build check that bans speaker embeddings and diarization identity vectors, including in vendor ASR settings pinned under R68, and allows front-end acoustic features only per utterance and in memory.

column3: Washington My Health My Data Act: health inferences from sensitive_event and the vulnerability counter
column4: Add a health-data quarantine. When a medical sensitive_event or a health lexicon hit fires, redact those spans from every retained transcript, audit sample and training set, and persist only a type-less sensitive_exit label. In MHMDA (and NV/CT) profiles, keep no health-derived data beyond the in-memory routing decision. Train the medical classes only on synthetic or consented data, have the build pipeline reject health-tagged real spans, and publish a consumer health data policy.

column3: ESIGN consumer-consent disclosure and inaccessible e-sign for a blind customer
column4: Before CONTRACT_SENT, ask a fixed question: electronic documents, or paper or an in-person signing? Paper, or any stated access need, routes to a mailed or consultant-assisted signing. The envelope runs a 7001(c) demonstration step (a code visible only inside a sample record in the contract's format). The vendor must meet WCAG 2.1 AA with tagged PDFs. Install waits until delivery of the disclosures is verified.

column3: Disability discrimination against direct callers with speech disabilities (dysarthria, stuttering, laryngectomy)
column5: Route repeated unintelligible turns with clear speech-present audio straight to a human. Never give such a call an AI callback, and flag the lead human-only. Add a consented atypical-speech stratum with "reached quote or human" parity as a release metric.

column3: State telemarketer registration and bonding (Texas ch. 302 as amended by SB 140) as an unmodeled pre-dial requirement
column4: Add a seller_registration row per state (TX ch. 302 as amended by SB 140, UT, WA and others) with registration id, bond or security, and expiry. Use it as a pre-dial and outbox guard, with texts counted as solicitation. Add a model-checked invariant: no DIAL and no SMS effect without valid registration in every candidate state. Raise an alert 30 days before expiry.

column3: E-signature attribution: OTP proves control of the phone, not identity, so one spouse signs for all record owners
column4: Each signer needs independently sourced contact data (their own consent or lead record, or a phone verified by lender KYC), and no two signers may share a phone or email. Any envelope that creates a lien or UCC filing requires per-signer vendor ID verification, with a notary or in-person consultant as the fallback. No lien filing or install proceeds until every owner has been independently verified.

column3: Shadow-mode evaluation cannot measure Needle's whole-call harm: after its first divergent label, the real call follows the big model's path
column4: Treat shadow agreement only as evidence for nominating a state. Whole-trace Tier A/B bounds and rule-of-three counts come only from calls where Needle actually drove the transitions. Promotion runs as a staged ramp: shadow, then a Needle-driven canary cohort with 100% human audit, then a wider cohort. The bound is recomputed at each stage, and any breach sends the state back to deterministic fallback.
column5: Log per call which policy drove each transition, so audited traces can be split cleanly into on-policy and off-policy.

column3: Constrained decoding renormalizes probability over allowed events, so the near-tie margin hides how much mass the model put outside the schema
column5: Single reserved token per event name, pre-mask off-schema mass as the OOD score (R19 should say it is read before masking), and full-sequence scoring of each allowed event for the margin.

column3: Multiple comparisons and winner's curse: hundreds of per-state, per-group, per-tier 95% bounds let bad states certify by chance
column5: Cumulative evidence for retried states (alpha-spending on all data so far, no restart from zero), and certification on a confirmatory sample collected after the promotion decision.

column3: Shortcut learning on generator artifacts: big-model synthetic examples carry label-correlated style tells that Needle learns instead of intent
column5: A per-source surface-only artifact probe each release, plus counterfactual minimal pairs (money words + stop, polite non-stop) as a Tier A red-team stratum.

column3: Train/serve skew on prosody tokens: synthetic training text carries "final-rise" tokens invented by the big model, not produced by the prosody detector
column5: Ban the big model from writing <rise>. Prosody tokens in training come only from the pinned detector run on real or TTS audio, or else are stripped from Needle's input. Per-dialect false-rise and missed-rise rates should be tracked.

column3: Train/test contamination: "finetune on the union of all data each release" absorbs red-team items, regression suites and golden canaries
column5: Content-hash denylist plus a near-duplicate and generator-lineage filter between every eval pool and the training union, enforced by a build check. Fixed red-team items should be reported separately from a fresh, never-trained red-team round each release.

column3: Rare n-gram quarantine (anti-poisoning) systematically removes dialect, code-switched and rare-name data, starving the groups the per-group bounds protect
column5: Require source concentration and label skew before quarantine, track the quarantine rate per dialect stratum with a disparity alarm, and give quarantined real items human review with a return path.

column3: Dialect/accent stratification needs a group label for every audited call, which is itself an unreliable and sensitive inference
column4: Define strata by observable linguistic and accent features (a Multi-VALUE feature checklist and L1-accent family), annotated by two trained auditors. Measure inter-rater agreement and use the confusion matrix to correct per-group estimates. Keep labels only on audit records under surrogate IDs, never in CRM, runtime or model inputs, and delete them with the gold item. Add a label-free worst-group check: unsupervised clusters over acoustic and ASR-confidence embeddings, with the worst cluster held to the same bound.

column3: Drift alarms at 1e-5 rates have detection delays of weeks to months, so harm accrues long before audited sampling can notice
column4: Run label-free drift monitors on 100% of traffic: per-state event-mix shift, clarify and near-tie rate, pre-mask off-schema mass, lexicon-vs-Needle disagreement rate, out_of_scope cluster growth, and hang-up-after-turn rate, all with CUSUM or sequential tests. Any alarm triggers an immediate 100% audit surge on the affected states. Affected Tier A states revert automatically to deterministic fallback until the surge clears.
column5: Queue every lexicon-vs-Needle stop disagreement for human audit, since it is the cheapest early signal of stop drift.

column3: Label-prior shift: upsampled rare safety events and per-source caps change Needle's class priors each release, silently moving stop and commit error rates
column5: A per-release calibration step on a separate real, audited split (temperature scaling plus BBSE/EM prior correction to measured deployment priors), with the calibrated thresholds shipped in the hashed bundle.

column3: Model-checked graph is not the binary that runs: StateSmith codegen and C toolchain supply chain
column4: Vendor StateSmith and the compiler by hash with reproducible builds; at release, enumerate the compiled binary's (state, event, abstract-guard) transition relation by harness and diff it against the exported graph (any extra edge fails the release); and add an independently written runtime trace monitor at the outbox that refuses CONTRACT_SENT or any commit effect unless the committed trace contains READ_BACK with a playback-engine completion mark for the same quote hash.
column5: Diverse double-compile with a second toolchain for the generated C.

column3: Security patching vs a certificate keyed on runtime build and hardware class
column5: State explicitly that a certificate re-keys to a patched runtime on bitwise-identical replay of the state's full gold set plus canary corpus, and keep Needle inference in a minimal sandbox (no network, no PII store) so perimeter patches never touch the certified hash.

column3: Forged or replayed e-sign webhooks advancing calls to SALE_PENDING
column4: Treat any inbound webhook as a wake-up hint only: on receipt, pull envelope status from the vendor API with the system's own credentials and make only that pulled status a StateSmith event; also require HMAC verification (with a build check that it is enabled), timestamp windows, envelope id stored in the session's outbox record with unknown or mismatched ids rejected, and monotonic status (void after completed goes to human review).

column3: Carrier failover changing codec and sample rate outside the certified bundle
column5: Make channel class (codec, sample rate, trunk/route) a certification stratum and key, run the golden-audio canary through each trunk's codec chain, and alarm per trunk on confidence and clarify rate within minutes.

column3: Distributed dialer race on frequency caps and DNC across workers and regions
column5: Implement the pre-dial gate as a linearizable per-number check-and-reserve (no read replicas, in-flight reservations counted, pending_sweep lock cleared only when the sweep commits, fail closed), with a TLA+-style spec as a release check.

column3: Clock, NTP and tzdata outside the content-hashed bundle drive calling-hours compliance
column4: Pin tzdata in the certified bundle and make the dial gate use only that copy; take time from at least three authenticated sources and fail closed when offset or uncertainty exceeds a small bound; shrink the lawful window by a guard band (wider on DST-transition days); and property-test the gate over every zone across DST boundaries, plus a daily per-zone test-dial canary.
column5: Two independent tz implementations whose disagreement blocks the dial.

column3: Blue/green rollback resurrecting superseded prices, warranties and legal rows
column4: Take the policy table out of rollback: it is forward-only, and recalled or withdrawn rows become tombstones no bundle can cite. Rollback restores graph, weights, fragments and ASR only, always runs against the current effective table, and may target only a retained bundle that is continuously re-checked (lints, fact-key coverage, gold replay) as compatible with that table; otherwise QUOTE/READ_BACK states drop to lead-gen or callback fallback. The runtime refuses any row outside its effective_from/until window.

column3: SIM-swap or port-out hijack defeats challenge-response identity and SMS-OTP e-sign
column5: A carrier SIM-change/port-out check before IDENTITY and before the OTP (a recent change means no sale on the call), plus a mailed notice to every record owner at the validated address through the existing print-and-mail outbox.

column3: Predictive-dialer pacing outrunning Needle fleet capacity causes abandoned calls
column5: Admission control that ties each dial permit to a live Needle capacity token, 1:1 pacing by default, a per-campaign rolling abandonment counter in the pre-dial gate, and callback slots drawn from a staffed-capacity calendar.

column3: Human-audit and replay pipeline forces retention of full raw audio with third-party labelers
column5: Label only in a controlled enclave (streaming VDI, no download, watermarking, access logs), mute IDENTITY-state and address segments by state timestamps, separate audio from name and number, and put a retention TTL on raw audio.

column3: Culturally deferential "yes" (face-saving acquiescence) passing the lexical COMMIT gate
column5: Make the commit an action-production prompt ("say 'send the contract'") and require a delayed teach-back after a run of bare affirms.

column3: High-context indirect refusals ("I'll consider it", "that's a little difficult") routed into booked callbacks
column4: Add an indirect_decline event class, trained from a high-context-refusal red-team stratum and bound by the decline invariants. Answer it with one fixed closed question ("Would you prefer we don't call again?"). Anything except an explicit time request suppresses the lead. A second non-committal defer on a later contact closes the lead and writes internal DNC. Extend the post-call sweep with the same lexicon.

column3: Non-Western name structures and gendered honorifics breaking the identity challenge and the greeting slot holes
column4: Use a token-set name matcher across the lead and county records that ignores order and normalizes compound surnames, particles, hyphens and romanization. An address match plus any surname-token match counts as VERIFIED. A partial match goes to clarify or a human, never to a WRONG_PARTY DNC. Add a release-blocking false-WRONG_PARTY stratum over synthetic name structures.

column3: Speech disabilities (dysarthria, aphasia, stammer, electrolarynx) filtered out by the ASR pre-gate with no disability stratum in certification
column4: Add speech-disability strata (dysarthria, stammer, aphasia, electrolarynx) with per-group release-blocking bounds. A number that hit an unintelligible fallback is routed only to a human on its next contact. Switch to an extended-timing profile (no speculation) after the first unintelligible turn. Add electrolarynx audio as near-field negatives for the media detector.

column3: Coerced owner: a relative, caregiver or abusive partner in the room scripting the owner's answers
column5: For owners 65+, a human owner-only confirmation call after signing and before install; any detected second voice during READ_BACK/COMMIT blocks the same-call close.

column3: E-sign SMS to "all record owners" exposing a domestic-violence survivor to an estranged co-owner
column4: Extend the consent gate to every outbound SMS and email, and never send a co-owner envelope to vendor-sourced contact data. The verified customer gets a "co-signer required" packet and chooses the channel, or the co-owner self-opts in via a link. Add a sensitive_event(household_safety) subtype that means no co-owner contact, no close, and a confidential human-review path.

column3: Financial distress and affordability absent from suitability: desperate homeowners pushed into liens they cannot carry
column5: An affordability suitability row (financed payment must not exceed the calculator-verified savings band, else NOT_SUITABLE or cash-only), explicit hardship lexicon rows, and PACE exclusion or ability-to-repay per the regulation profile.

column3: Yes-ladder conditioning inside DISCOVERY/QUALIFY (the lint bans yes-eliciting openers only)
column5: Extend the leading-question lint (tag questions, value-laden yes-questions) to every state and add a whole-path cap on expected affirms before READ_BACK.

column3: Hypomanic or manic buyers: high enthusiasm reads as the ideal close, not as vulnerability
column5: Sign me up before a quote, or requests above the calculated size, should block the same-call close in favor of a written proposal and a cooling-off period.

column3: Lonely, isolated but lucid customers buying to keep the conversation going
column5: A small_talk reply budget (≤2), no icebreaker re-entry after DISCOVERY, and a fixed "there's no need to decide today" fragment before READ_BACK.

column3: Lender dealer fees buried in the "total cost" the policy table and calculator quote, so the cash and financed prices silently diverge
column5: A build and runtime invariant that the e-sign contract amount and lender amount equal the quote-hash amount read back, with cash and financed price stated side by side in READ_BACK.

column3: Net price quoted after a capped, first-come incentive that is exhausted or needs a reservation by the time of install
column4: Type incentive rows (guaranteed / capped / reservation_required). Capped and reservation rows can never reduce the quoted or read-back price. READ_BACK states the gross contract price and the incentive only as "if approved, not guaranteed". A net price may be spoken only with a program_reserved provenance slot set by a program or installer API event. A daily program-status feed expires capped rows. The contract carries an incentive-failure no-penalty cancel clause, and the reservation is filed inside the cancellation window.

column3: Verified usage can't be obtained on a cold call: utility interval data requires the account holder's separate authorization
column5: A usage-authorization outbox effect (Green Button Connect or utility-portal link, or a bill upload with a deterministic extractor) as the only writer of verified_usage, authorized by the utility account holder, with an OTP-gated resume to deliver the savings figure.

column3: Savings depend on a future utility tariff and rate-escalation assumption, not on usage; NEM changes make the certified savings fragment a forecast stated as fact
column4: Add an "assumption" provenance type for escalation and future-rate rows. Any fragment filled from one must carry a lint-enforced "estimate, assumes X, not guaranteed" qualifier. The default savings figure uses today's rates only, and any projection is paired with a zero-escalation case. The calculator must use the customer's exact tariff schedule (e.g. NBT hourly export) on verified interval data, else no figure. A tariff-filing monitor expires rows. Escalator-lease READ_BACK states the year-1 and final-year payments.

column3: Interconnection and permission-to-operate gap: loan payments and the "installed" success label arrive before the utility lets the system run
column4: Redefine success as PTO granted plus N months of monitored production plus no complaint across the whole window, with labels provisional until then. Add policy-table rows required in READ_BACK and the contract: utility interconnection approval required, possible utility-side upgrade cost and who pays it, and the exact loan first-payment event. Make an install-to-PTO lag over threshold, and any "paying, not operating" state, Tier A harm signals per branch.

column3: Post-signature site survey change orders (main panel upgrade, reroof, trenching, structural) changing the price after the read-back the commit was gated on
column4: Schedule the site survey inside the cancellation window and make the contract contingent on a survey-confirmed price. Every change order becomes a new quote hash with written re-disclosure, a fresh e-sign by all signers, a no-penalty exit and a restart of the cancellation window. Install is blocked until then. Add main-panel amperage and roof-structure slots. When they are unknown, READ_BACK must state "price subject to survey" with policy-table cost ranges. An unconsented price increase is Tier A harm.

column3: Equipment substitution after signing (tariffs, supply shortages, discontinued SKUs) making the named product and warranties in the read-back false
column4: Gate the install effect on WAITING_FOR_BOM_MATCH, comparing the installer's planned SKUs (then installed serials) to the signed config hash. On a mismatch, block install and require a written re-disclosure of the new product, warranty and degradation terms plus a fresh e-sign with a no-penalty cancel. Add a supply-status field to product rows that expires discontinued or tariff-hit SKUs. Count an un-reconsented substitution as Tier A harm.

column3: Installer or partner insolvency leaving the named workmanship and production warranties with no one behind them
column5: A counterparty-health monitor (bankruptcy filings, missed-milestone rates, lender watch-lists) that automatically expires a partner's warranty rows and suppresses dialing, plus READ_BACK naming who backs each warranty and preferring warranties with a backing instrument.

column3: Dealer or lead-partner fraud through the lead record: fabricated identity answers and partner-controlled phone numbers receiving the e-sign OTP
column4: Draw identity-challenge answers only from independent sources (public records, KYC vendor), never from partner lead fields. Run a pre-dial phone-to-record-owner match (carrier or identity graph); with no match, the call is lead-gen only. Require lender-grade identity verification (document plus selfie or KBA) for each record owner at e-sign. Mail a contract summary with cancel instructions to the property address of record and hold install for a set time after it. Track per-partner fraud metrics with auto-suspension, and use an independent consent-capture provider.

column3: Success labels from the CRM, controlled by installers and ops staff who are paid on them, gamed to certify bad branches
column4: Source outcome labels first from independent feeds (outbox post-install customer survey, AG/CFPB/BBB complaint feeds, lender disputes and delinquency, cancellation API logs, utility PTO records), which override CRM fields. Make CRM outcome fields append-only with signed, attributed edits and two-person approval for reclassifications or backdates. Sample suitability audits from the e-sign webhook list of all signed contracts. Raise a Tier A alarm on divergence between CRM and independent complaint rates per installer, and decouple ops and installer bonuses from training labels.

column3: The COMMIT gate's acceptance shape (short lexical "yeah/okay") is exactly the shape of ASR insertions and hallucinations on non-speech
column5: The voicing-evidence gate on commit tokens (ASR word timestamps aligned with pinned VAD/voicing frames) plus a non-speech red-team stratum at AWAIT_CONFIRM.

column3: TTS is not in the certified bundle, so certified text is not certified audio
column4: Pin the TTS engine, voice, normaliser config and seed in the certified bundle. Give every policy row an authored spoken form that code verbalises before TTS, so no symbols or abbreviations reach the normaliser. Pre-render every fact-bearing clip at build time with an audio hash and a pinned-ASR round-trip check against the spoken form. Extend the daily canary to compare output audio, and decertify on any diff.
column5: n/a

column3: Network latency makes server-side "overlap" and "uninterrupted" flags wrong from the caller's point of view
column5: Measure one-way delay per call (RTCP RR/DLSR) and widen the overlap and playback windows by that delay plus a jitter margin. Lint the commit question as a separate fragment after a fixed pause.

column3: One-way audio: the preamble plays into a dead media path and is logged as delivered
column4: Make media health a root telephony event. Write a mandatory segment's delivered flag only if far-end RTCP receiver reports show the agent's RTP arriving with acceptable loss across that segment's span. If reports are missing, or the callee keeps repeating "hello?" or giving no response, enter MEDIA_FAULT: hang up and book a lawful callback that starts again from PREAMBLE, or replay the full PREAMBLE once the path is confirmed. Add one-way-RTP fault injection in every state.
column5: n/a

column3: The caller's half-duplex speakerphone or echo canceller removes their "stop" while the agent is talking
column5: Treat a hangup during agent playback, or overlap residue containing stop-adjacent tokens, as suppress-pending until review. Add a maximum-fragment-duration lint.

column3: The OPENING's wait-for-callee and machine detection create TSR "abandoned calls" and dead-air hang-ups
column4: Add a regulation-profile invariant that the first PREAMBLE segment starts within about 1.5 s of the completed greeting, measured per call. AMD may not delay past that deadline, and an unresolved AMD result is treated as human. Enter VOICEMAIL only on a beep or confirmed machine cue, never on greeting length alone. Add a per-campaign 30-day abandonment counter capped at 3%, with the safe-harbor recorded message on abandon, and halt dialing on a breach.
column5: n/a

column3: The final-rise prosody token fails on narrowband telephone audio and on habitual uptalk
column5: Certify the prosody detector on its own, with per-pitch-range false-rise bounds. Abstain (emit no token) when voicing confidence is low, and normalise against the caller's own F0 baseline from earlier turns.

column3: Atypical speech (dysarthria, Parkinson's, post-stroke, electrolarynx) routed into "unintelligible" or vulnerability exits
column4: Add speech-disability strata (dysarthria, hypophonia, stuttering, electrolarynx, aphasia) to the gold sets, using consented data. Make per-group false-unintelligible, false-vulnerability and fallback rates release blockers. Exclude unintelligible, low-ASR-confidence and pure-ASR-quality unclear events from the vulnerability counter. After repeated unintelligible re-asks, route to an ACCESS_PATH (DTMF answers, SMS/web self-serve, or a human with extra time) that is counted as an access failure, never a safe exit, and never suppresses redial.
column5: n/a

column3: A party who joins mid-call (extension pickup, three-way merge) never hears the preamble, and there is no telephony event to say so
column4: Make speaker_change() enter a NEW_PARTY state that replays the compiled disclosure block (AI designation, seller, purpose, recording, opt-out) as mandatory segments before any further pitch, and revert recording to NO_RETAIN until the new party consents. Play a short compiled re-disclosure at the start of READ_BACK to cover silent listeners. Require the affirming speaker's diarization id to match the VERIFIED speaker at the commit gate.
column5: n/a

column3: No-retain and recording-failure calls blind the post-call DNC sweep and drop out of the audited harm measure
column4: Make the teardown sweep mandatory before purge, with an attestation log, and suppress the number if the sweep fails or no transcript exists (fail closed, including for recording or transcript fork faults). Treat NO_RETAIN as its own stratum with a conservative profile: any unresolved unclear in the closing turns or any Tier-2 stop suppresses redial. Bound its harm with outcome proxies (later complaints, repeat DNC requests, rescissions) compared against the retained stratum, and state the coverage gap explicitly in the certification report.
column5: Where lawful, ask for consent to a short-lived, audit-only retention so that a sample of NO_RETAIN-profile calls can be human-labeled.

column3: Condo/HOA owner "owns" the home but the roof is association common area needing board approval, insurance and roof-removal duties
column4: Add a governance slot sourced from county parcel data (common-interest development or recorded CC&R flag), plus one neutral QUALIFY question. An HOA or common-element roof goes to an HOA_APPROVAL_FIRST suitability row: no price and no close on the call, lead-gen plus a written proposal. Where a close is allowed, a policy-table row "association approval required; may impose insurance, maintenance and removal duties" is mandatory in READ_BACK and the contract, with a no-penalty cancel on denial or conditions. Install is blocked until written approval is on file.

column3: Manufactured/mobile home on a leased park lot: chattel title, no land ownership, wrong lien instrument
column4: Add a structure_type slot from the parcel use code and the state manufactured-housing title registry (HCD in CA), never from speech. Manufactured, chattel-titled or land-lease homes go to NOT_SUITABLE for the residential product row (honest exit plus referral) or to human review. Make the lien/UCC READ_BACK fragment a policy-table key per collateral type, chosen only by the lender's stated security instrument. Add a HUD-code roof-load row.

column3: Home held in a revocable living trust: record owner is a trustee capacity, not a person with a phone
column5: Run the deceased-list check against every record owner on title, and have the human path obtain a certification of trust with "as trustee" signature blocks for the current trustees.

column3: Executor or heir in a probate estate encumbering a decedent's house without court or beneficiary authority
column5: Add an estate/probate lexicon and event that blocks quote and close, and suppress properties with a deceased record owner from sales campaigns until title transfers.

column3: Pending divorce: automatic restraining orders forbid encumbering the home, and the "move horizon" answer hides a court-ordered sale
column5: Ask one neutral QUALIFY question about any expected ownership change (sale, refinance, divorce, estate), and have the lender's title pull check for a lis pendens or family-law filing before the lien.

column3: Non-owner-occupied rental: tenant pays the electric bill, so certified savings go to someone else, and the loan stops being consumer credit
column4: Add an owner_occupied slot: one QUALIFY question cross-checked against homestead-exemption and mailing-address records, with disagreement going to clarify and then a human. Non-owner-occupied goes to NOT_SUITABLE for the consumer product, with referral to a human commercial desk. Any savings figure requires bill_payer equal to a signing record owner, else no figure. Add an invariant that consumer-credit and home-solicitation fragments are reachable only when owner_occupied is verified.

column3: Duplex/triplex with separate meters: system sized and priced on one unit's usage, interconnected to one meter
column5: Add a unit_count slot from the parcel use code and a service-point list from the utility API, and have READ_BACK name the meter the system ties into.

column3: Owner of several properties answers qualifying questions about the house they're in while the contract binds the lead-record address
column5: Put the validated street slot into QUALIFY fragments and require the property address in READ_BACK by lint. Cross-check roof age against permit records, with any disagreement going to ROOF_FIRST.

column3: Farmhouse on a shared agricultural meter: "verified usage" includes irrigation pumps and barns on a farm tariff
column5: Add an explicit tariff_class key on calculator rows from the utility API. Any non-residential class goes to NOT_SUITABLE for the residential product, and entity owners go to human review with no same-call close.

column3: Contract-for-deed (land installment) buyer: occupant believes they own it, while legal title and the e-sign recipient are a third-party seller
column5: Add an OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH state with one fixed question and an honest written explanation, plus a land-contract lexicon that leads to NOT_SUITABLE with a note to check the contract's alteration and lien clauses.

column3: Batch-variant inference on the pinned Needle fleet makes certified near-tie decisions depend on how many other calls are in flight
column4: Run certified inference with batch-invariant kernels (fixed reduction order and split sizes), or at batch size 1 per pass. Put the batching policy in the certificate key. Add a release CI test that replays every gold set under random co-batched load at sizes 1..N and requires bitwise-identical tokens and margin decisions.
column5: Log the batch size per Needle call so any production/replay divergence can be traced.

column3: The argument grounding gate is a presence check, so partial spans and truncated values pass ("150" is found inside "1500")
column5: State in R61 that grounding means exact equality with one complete extracted entity at token boundaries. Two candidate values for one slot go to clarify(slot), and argument truncation counts as an error.

column3: Grounding accepts the right string bound to the wrong role or under negation (argument swap and scope errors)
column5: A deterministic negation-scope and slot-cue cross-check in the extractor, and one numeric slot per QUALIFY question.

column3: Constrained decoding masks are written in characters but Needle emits subword tokens, so some valid argument values are unreachable or forced into tokenizations Needle never saw
column5: Compile argument masks at token level over the tokenizer vocabulary. Use reserved single tokens for argument enums (e.g. battery vs battery_backup). Decode fine-tuning data through the same grammar.

column3: Encoder context overflow: state tool schemas plus agent context plus a long caller turn exceed Needle's input window, and truncation silently cuts the caller's last words or the tail of the tool list
column5: A build check that tool-schema tokens plus the maximum segment fit the encoder window in every state, with silent truncation disabled and over-length input routed to re-segmentation and then clarify.

column3: The "exactly one event" constraint collapses multi-intent turns, so logits decide which of two safety intents survives
column4: Make GLOBAL multi-label: each safety event gets its own calibrated threshold and every event above it fires, handled in a fixed order (DNC write, then cancel, then identity/human answers; any transfer carries the DNC flag and is service-only). Add a cancel/rescind lexicon to the deterministic union, and extend the post-call sweep to cancel intents. Add "do-not-call" and "do not call list" to Tier 1, plus a bundled-intent Tier A stratum.

column3: GLOBAL and LOCAL are scored by separate softmaxes over different label sets, so a strong-but-sub-threshold safety signal is discarded while LOCAL commits
column5: A joint safety-mass veto: in commit-capable states, any calibrated GLOBAL safety probability above a low threshold blocks commit and triggers one closed question about that event.

column3: Fragment wording variants change Needle's input distribution, but certification is keyed by fragment id, not by wording
column5: For fragments that come before AWAIT_* states, key the certificate on (fragment id, wording id), so a new wording starts uncertified. Add a lint that bans compound questions in AWAIT fragments.

column3: Hierarchical statechart precedence: a substate that handles the same event shadows the root GLOBAL exit
column5: An explicit per-pair invariant that, for every state and every GLOBAL event, the effective handler on the enumerated binary relation is the root exit. Add a lint that fails the build if any substate declares a trigger named in the GLOBAL set.

column3: StateSmith machines are single-threaded run-to-completion code with no event queue, so concurrent event sources are serialized by hand-written glue outside the model check
column4: Use a single-writer actor per session. All event sources enqueue into one FIFO mailbox, drained by one thread that calls dispatch() run-to-completion. dispatch asserts non-reentrancy and fails closed. Events carry a session epoch, and stale ones are dropped. Model-check the mailbox glue over all interleavings (e.g. TLA+), and add random-interleaving fault injection that must yield only legal traces.

column3: Active-duty military buyers: Military Lending Act terms and PCS-order move horizons the uniform "same menu for all" financing cannot handle
column5: Require covered_borrower as a lender_verified slot before QUOTE. When it is true, use an MLA contract template (no arbitration, MAPR including the dealer fee ≤ 36%, else cash-only) and add the MLA oral-disclosure fragment to READ_BACK. Hedge words on move_horizon clamp the slot to its shortest row.

column3: Homeowner in an active Chapter 13 bankruptcy, legally barred from taking on new debt or liens without trustee or court approval
column5: Bankruptcy lexicon rows ("chapter 7/13", "trustee", "plan payment") firing sensitive_event(financial_hardship) with human review, plus a public-record bankruptcy flag on record owners that is checked before any lien or install effect.

column3: Probate and estate-owned homes: an heir passes the identity challenge and commits a house titled to a dead person
column5: Check the death index and probate filings at record-owner lookup. Drop KBA as an option for lien envelopes, since family members can answer it. Bind VERIFIED to a specific record-owner name, with a surname-only match treated as a household member (no close).

column3: HOA architectural approval and state-specific solar-access law: approval arrives after the cancellation window and moves or shrinks the system
column5: An hoa slot from deed-restriction lookup. READ_BACK says "subject to HOA approval" where one applies, and the HOA application is filed inside the cancellation window. Any HOA-mandated layout change, including orientation, counts explicitly as a change order. Answers about HOA rights come from jurisdiction-keyed rows only.

column3: Contractor licence status changing daily at state licensing boards (suspensions, bond or workers' comp lapses) outside the certified policy table
column4: Add installer_license rows per jurisdiction (CSLB, AZ ROC, FL DBPR and others) fed by an automated daily pull of board status plus bond and workers'-comp feeds. Each row's effective_until is at most 24 hours after its last successful check, and a stale feed fails closed. Model-checked invariant: no QUOTE, READ_BACK, CONTRACT_SENT or install effect unless the installer's licence row is valid for the property's jurisdiction. Re-check at install. A lapse after signing holds install, sends written notice and offers a no-penalty cancel.
column5: Make "licensed" a fragment that only fills from a row checked within the last 24 hours.

column3: Post-hurricane ROOF_FIRST outcomes colliding with Florida's ban on contractors soliciting insurance-claim roof work
column5: Add an out_of_scope(insurance_claim) event with a fixed "we can't discuss claims or coverage" fragment and a lint banning claim, deductible and adjuster tokens. Storm-state profile rows (FL 489.147, TX Ins. 707) turn ROOF_FIRST after a declaration into a neutral written exit with no roofer referral.

column3: PACE (property-tax-assessment) financing: a tax lien, not a loan, with its own solicitation bans, recorded confirmation call and ability-to-pay rules
column5: A build check that types every financing row (loan, lease, PPA, PACE) and fails any PACE row without a full PACE profile (DFPI licensing, recorded oral confirmation, ability-to-pay, annual-assessment and lien-priority read-back items). A lint bans tax-benefit wording except "consult a tax professional".

column3: Homes on tribal trust land: leasehold title, BIA approval for encumbrances, and tribal (not state) consumer, contractor and utility law
column4: Add a tribal jurisdiction layer (BIA land-area and Census AIANNH boundaries checked on the validated address). An address on trust or reservation land loads a tribal profile, and with no certified profile the call is lead-gen only, goes to a human consultant, and offers no lien or UCC product. Record-owner lookup that returns no fee owner, or a trust owner, fails closed to human review. Utilities missing from the tariff table force no figure.

column3: Texas homestead constitutional lien rules: SMS e-sign cannot meet the required signing location, waiting period, spousal consent and rescission steps
column4: Add a TX homestead profile row keyed on the county homestead exemption. Any lien or UCC product on such a home makes the call lead-gen only. Closing happens only at a title company, lender or attorney office, signalled by a closing_venue event. A 5-day timer runs from the application timestamp, both spouses sign (including a spouse not on title), and there is a 3-day rescission. Model-checked invariant: no lien-filing effect without the closing_venue event. Cash and no-lien products may still e-sign.

column3: Travelling or roaming callers: calling-hours rules apply at the called party's physical location, which neither the address nor the area code gives
column4: Add a GLOBAL current_location event (lexicon plus Needle, with a certified small_talk confusion pair) for "I'm in/abroad/travelling", "middle of the night" and "you woke me". It adds the stated place's time zone to the candidate set. Outside the window, the agent apologizes and ends with a callback in the caller's stated local time. It also writes a number-level away_until hold into the dial permit so later waves skip the number. A stated absence from home means no same-call close.

column3: No leave-taking event: "okay, thanks, bye" is neither stop/DNC nor anything else, so it is labeled acknowledge and the pitch continues
column5: A leave_taking lexicon class (bye / bye now / gotta go / heard enough) that plays one fixed "Thanks for your time, goodbye" fragment, then hangs up and suppresses the lead as an indirect_decline. Also add a pre-closing red-team stratum.

column3: The unskippable seven-segment preamble plus "counts only on uninterrupted playback" turns a normal "Hello? Hello?" pickup into a restart loop
column5: An ordered preamble with a short lint-capped first segment (seller, sales purpose, AI), a cap of 2 replays per segment followed by a polite end, and a per-segment interruption-rate metric.

column3: How did you get my number? / "I never signed up for anything" have no event, no fragment and no consequence, though consent is the call's legal basis
column4: Add a GLOBAL consent_source_question event. Its fixed fragment states the seller, capture date and capture channel from the R74 artifact, and the outbox texts a copy of the consent record. Add a GLOBAL consent_dispute event (lexicon plus Needle): no further pitch, a DNC or suppression write through the R115 bus, legal_hold on the session (R117), an increment to the R162 partner-fraud counter, and a human audit of that lead's consent. Add a red-team stratum of consent-denial phrasings and a Tier A metric for a denial followed by a redial.

column3: Icebreaker replies carry no valence: small_talk/acknowledge have no sentiment slot, so the canned acknowledgment can cheer bad news that falls short of a sensitive_event
column5: A lint that allows a valence-presuming acknowledgment only on the matching valence. valence=negative gets a sympathetic fragment plus "Is now a bad time?", which routes to a callback or a polite end.

column3: Unsafe-context replies ("I'm driving, but go ahead") aren't events, so the agent runs READ_BACK and pushes an SMS e-sign with OTP to a driver
column4: Add a GLOBAL unsafe_context(driving | operating_machinery | working) event, fired by a lexicon ("driving", "on the freeway", "behind the wheel") or by Needle. It plays a fixed fragment ("Please don't use your phone while driving. When's a better time?") and routes to callback_request or a polite end. Add a model-checked invariant: once unsafe_context is set, READ_BACK, COMMIT and CONTRACT_SENT/OTP are unreachable on that call, and no fragment may tell the caller to act on the handset.

column3: Bad lines (car Bluetooth, wind, dropouts): "clarify once, then fallback" turns noisy calls into booked callbacks or warm transfers nobody agreed to, and a garbled stop goes nowhere
column4: Any call that ends on unintelligible fallback books nothing and ends with "I'm having trouble hearing you; I'll let you go." The number stays under the R138 pending_sweep lock until a human has listened to every low-confidence or unintelligible span for an opt-out. A stop-adjacent token in any such span means DNC. The ACCESS_PATH no-suppression exception applies only after that human review clears the call.

column3: Call outcomes never write back to the pre-dial gate: WRONG_PARTY, NOT_SUITABLE, tenants and preamble hang-ups get redialed
column5: An outcome-to-suppression table in the policy table (NOT_SUITABLE suppresses for a period set by its suitability row; two preamble hang-ups close the lead) and a model-checked invariant that every END state writes back an effect that the R138 dial permit reads.

column3: The IDENTITY challenge-response is a phishing script: an unsolicited caller asks you to confirm personal details, the exact pattern the preamble's anti-phishing line and FTC advice tell people to refuse
column5: An identity_refusal event that approves of the caution, sends the verify_agent text, offers the published inbound number and ends without a pitch. Also make the anti-phishing line list exactly what is never asked ("Social Security, bank or card numbers").

column3: The success-path goodbye after a verbal yes ("You're all set, welcome aboard") misstates the deal's status before any signature, chilling cancellation and making people ignore the e-sign text
column5: A status-claim lint keyed to state. Before SALE_SIGNED, ban "all set", "welcome", "congratulations", "you're done" and "purchased". The CONTRACT_SENT closing fragment must say nothing is final until signing and give {cancel_window}.

column3: Hang-up race at the end: the caller's last words during or right after the closing fragment land after the terminal state and are lost
column5: A short listen window (endpointing plus about 2 s) in WRAP_UP before BYE, with late ASR routed to a POST_CALL handler. A sweep hit for cancel_or_rescind voids the envelope through the vendor API and sends written confirmation.

column3: Follow-up and upsell calls to borrowers who are behind on their solar loan become debt-collection communications
column5: Use the lender delinquency feed (R163) as a pre-dial suppression input for every existing-customer campaign. Add a lint that bans fragments naming the existing loan, lender, balance or payment, and a Tier A third-party-disclosure red-team stratum with spouses and relatives who pass the R146 match.

column3: Bankruptcy automatic stay and discharge injunction ignored by follow-up and upgrade campaigns
column5: Run a PACER/servicer bankruptcy scrub in the pre-dial gate, with suppression that only counsel can lift. Add a sensitive_event(bankruptcy) subtype that sets legal_hold, and a lint that bans eligibility wording tied to the status of an existing debt.

column3: A spoken cancellation to the bot neither meets the written-notice requirement nor reaches the separate lender contract, the UCC filing and the install schedule
column4: Turn CANCEL into a saga. One cancel intent fans out to the seller contract API, the lender envelope void or loan cancellation, a UCC hold or termination, and the installer slot release. Each party gets its own WAITING_FOR substate and idempotency key, and the customer is told cancellation is complete only after every party acknowledges. Add an invariant: no loan funding, UCC filing or install while any cancel is open. Treat oral cancellation to the agent as valid notice under the contract, and also send the pre-filled statutory form by e-sign and mail. The spoken fragment says "started", not "recorded/done".

column3: Lender milestone funding and deposits that exceed home-improvement payment limits, and a read-back with no start date or progress-payment schedule
column4: Add a home_improvement_contract row in each regulation profile (CA 7159 and analogues) with required keyed fields: estimated start and completion dates (ranges allowed when tied to permits) and a progress-payment schedule. A build and runtime check fails any contract or read-back that lacks them. Compute the deposit effect as at most min(cap amount, cap %) from the profile, and have the outbox refuse anything larger. Admit a lender program into a profile only if its draw milestones never pay ahead of work performed. Make paying for work not yet done a Tier A harm signal.

column3: Lease or PPA "escalator" contracts read back without the home-sale transfer, buyer qualification and buyout terms that decide what happens when the customer sells
column5: Add a mandatory transfer_on_sale material-limitation row for every lease and PPA (transferee credit check, possible conditions from the buyer's lender, assume/buyout/prepay options), with buyout values at fixed contract years in READ_BACK and a full table in the contract.

column3: Ownership changes between signature and installation (sale, move, death, divorce) with no re-check of record owners before work starts or the lien is recorded
column4: Add a WAITING_FOR_TITLE_RECHECK gate within N days before install and again immediately before any UCC filing. It re-runs the record-owner lookup and checks recorded deeds and transfers, listing and escrow feeds, the deceased list and capacity flags, and every signer reconfirms through their verified channel. Any change blocks install and filing and goes to human review. The current owners must re-sign, or the contract is cancelled with no penalty. A stale-title install is Tier A harm.

column3: Dual-purpose follow-up calls: the same compiled agent making install-scheduling or survey calls turns them into telemarketing, or announces a false purpose
column5: Make call_purpose a typed field on both campaign and bundle, enforced by the dialer, and give the SERVICE profile a model-checked invariant that no marketing-tagged fragment is reachable.

column3: The agent's own follow-up calls are the complaint intake, so its label taxonomy decides whether the success label ever sees a complaint
column5: Define "complaint" in policy, independent of the routing label. Count every existing-customer service_issue as a complaint against its originating sales branch until a human clears it, and make the per-branch service_issue rate a Tier A metric.

column3: Warranty rows in the policy table that carry illegal tie-in or void-on-repair conditions, read back as certified fact
column5: Extend the banned-claims lint to policy-table row text, contract templates and backer instruments, flagging tie-in and void-on-repair patterns. Require a per-jurisdiction legal attestation field (MMWA 2302(c), state right-to-repair) before a warranty row can be cited.

column3: ACH disputes and chargebacks on deposits or first payments taken by bank debit, where the redactor and no-retain mode destroy the "express verifiable authorization" the TSR requires
column5: Specify the hosted page's capture: amount, dates, number of debits, last 4 digits, account-holder name, customer-service number, E-SIGN signature and joint-holder attestation. Store it in the R116 WORM set keyed to the session, and add an invariant: no debit effect without a stored authorization.

column3: Competitor sabotage by spoofed inbound calls that rescind signed contracts and opt out live leads
column5: The inbound-cancel anomaly alarm (STIR/SHAKEN B/C/none, cancel clusters per lead source) and a customer-only "this wasn't me" reinstate that needs an OTP to the number of record and a fresh e-sign.

column3: Identity challenge-response as a PII enumeration oracle for fraudsters and data brokers
column4: Inbound IDENTITY must answer match and mismatch with the same fixed fragment and timing ("we'll text a code to the number on file"). Only an OTP entered from the number of record unlocks VERIFIED or any personalized or QUALIFY fragment. Add attempt counters keyed by lead and address across all ANIs, with lockout to human-only plus a mailed notice, and a red-team test that timing and fragment ids can't be told apart.

column3: SMS pumping and toll fraud through the e-sign OTP, envelope resends and "outbox copy" messages
column5: Per-number, per-session and per-campaign SMS budgets; a NANP-mobile-only deny-list for premium and IPRN ranges; a global SMS-spend circuit breaker; and DNC-policy copies sent at most once per number per 30 days.

column3: Consent bombing: third parties file "prior express written consent" forms for numbers they don't own
column4: A PEWC artifact is valid only if the form-filler entered a one-time code sent at submission to that number (double opt-in), and the verification record is stored in the consent artifact. Add form velocity controls per IP, device and ASN, with burst quarantine (never dialed). Add a consent_dispute event ("I never signed up") that writes DNC and quarantines the whole submission cluster, with a per-source dispute-rate Tier A metric and auto-suspension.

column3: AI-verified tickets and warm transfers launder an impostor's requests to human ops
column4: Use a typed handoff contract carrying verification_strength (knowledge_only / otp_number_of_record / lender_kyc), never a bare VERIFIED. Ticket and transfer schemas get no fields for a new phone, email, address or payee, and callbacks go only to the contact of record. Add a CRM-enforced rule that no contact, payee or autopay change comes from an agent-originated ticket or transfer without an out-of-band OTP to the old contact of record, a mailed notice and a cooling delay.

column3: Insider logic bomb hidden among a fragment's approved alternative wordings
column4: Add a build check that the wording selector's only input is hash(session_id, fragment_id), so no slot or customer attribute reaches it. Every wording needs two-person approval (author plus an independent compliance reviewer) with signed commits. Add a quantifier and aggregate lint ("most", "nothing out of pocket") that requires a table key. Each new wording gets a 100%-audited canary and a minimum live audit quota per release, plus a matched-pair test of the wording-id distribution across age bands.

column3: Corrupt or infiltrated human audit labelers poison the ground truth that gates certification
column5: Blind planted gold calls in every labeler's queue, with a gold-accuracy gate and retroactive label drops; per-labeler and per-vendor concentration caps per stratum; adjudicators distinct from first-pass labelers; and an independent second-vendor re-audit slice before certification.

column3: Threats of violence, swatting and doxxing aimed at installers and reps hit a closed scripted exit
column4: Add a threat_to_others GLOBAL event (lexicon plus Needle, also re-run in the post-call sweep). It plays a fixed neutral fragment, ends the call and sets a safety_hold. The hold reuses legal_hold to freeze deletion and keeps caller audio where the profile allows, or otherwise an incident record. It pages a staffed safety team and blocks every consult, survey and install dispatch to that address and number until a human clears it. Add a red-team stratum with a Tier A false-negative bound.

column3: Flooding request_human and booked in-home consults to exhaust closers and lure reps to an address
column4: An in-home consult needs an OTP to the independently sourced number of record; otherwise the booking is a phone or video consult. Cap active consults at one per address and N per ANI or range per week, with a repeat-address alarm. Give OTP-verified callers transfer priority, and give unverified request_human a guaranteed callback to the number of record. Add a rep safety protocol: daylight slots by default, check-in and check-out with an escalation timer, a second person on flagged bookings, and a pre-visit confirmation call to the number of record.

column3: Insider poaching at the human handoff: closers divert transferred customers to side deals or rivals
column5: An allowlisted handoff schema (name, verification_strength, product interest, quote-hash pointer) that never carries the vulnerability counter or hardship flags. Closers work only in a recorded softphone or CRM with access logging and bulk-export blocks.

column3: Label leakage through agent-side context: the state's tool list and the preceding fragment predict the event, so Needle learns "what this state usually hears", not what the caller said
column5: The context-only leakage probe (state, tool list and fragment with no caller text must not beat the per-state class prior), plus generation prompted by target event with a balanced mix per state.

column3: The teacher's covert dialect prejudice becomes the label set: the big model, as stand-in classifier and synthetic labeler, scores dialect speakers as hostile, unclear or out of scope
column5: Measure teacher-vs-human disagreement per dialect stratum each release, and bar teacher labels for any stratum where the disparity is above threshold.

column3: The teacher's own safety alignment sanitizes the safety-critical classes: it refuses or softens realistic suicidal, abusive, threatening and fraud-seeking caller turns
column4: Make missed sensitive_event and unlawful_request turns Tier A, with human-audited gold only. Run a sanitization audit per class each release that compares generator refusal rate and explicitness against a human-written oblique set, and block release if it fails. Source oblique examples from consented, crisis-informed human writers. Add passive-ideation and indirect-threat lexicon rows to the deterministic pre-emption, with the scripted sensitive exit, and give sensitive_event a recall-biased per-event threshold in the R189 multi-label GLOBAL pass.

column3: Simulated ASR noise does not match the pinned ASR's real confusion profile, so Needle is robust to errors the real ASR never makes
column5: Ban LLM-written ASR errors. Build noisy text only from TTS through channel simulation, the pinned ASR and the canonicalizer, plus an empirical confusion model fitted on audited real calls (the R128 precedent applied to text).

column3: Event-schema growth leaves historical labels wrong: when an out_of_scope cluster becomes a new event, all older data still teaches the old label
column5: A schema-migration step: a label-map spec for each schema version, parent-labeled items marked stale on a split, human relabeling or regeneration, masking of unresolved items, and a build check on the stale fraction.

column3: Training examples are not keyed to the graph version they were labeled against, so tool renames, merges and description edits mix incompatible supervision
column5: Store (graph version, tool-list hash, description hash, label-map version) on every training item, re-render state context from the current graph at train time, and mask any item that has no verified migration path.

column3: The teacher model is a moving, retirable API, so the synthetic training set cannot be reproduced and a certified build can't be rebuilt
column5: Content-hash each release's training corpus, with teacher model id and version, prompts, seeds and sampling parameters, into the bundle manifest and WORM archive, and prefer a self-hosted, version-pinned teacher.

column3: Audit labelers anchored on the model's proposed label (automation bias) contaminate the human ground truth that gates certification
column4: Label Tier A gold blind: the UI shows no Needle or teacher label, playback is fixed at 1x, and a random share is double-labeled blind with adjudication. Seed known-answer items and remove labelers who fall below an accuracy floor. Allow pre-fill only for Tier B, and correct those estimates by the bias measured against blind double labels.

column3: Adaptive overfitting to a reused certification and golden set: release-by-release tuning of thresholds, caps and data mixes against the same audited pools
column5: Log a per-release query budget on the exploration pool, and seal each confirmatory sample by content hash at collection.

column3: Retraining cadence vs certification evidence: an urgent fix needs new weights, and new weights reset the real-call evidence every state needs
column5: A same-day lexicon hotfix lane that replays all retained gold sets for false-stop rate before compliance sign-off, plus separately trained and hashed GLOBAL and LOCAL weights, so a safety retrain doesn't void LOCAL certificates.

column3: Tax-credit "re-amortization" loans: the quoted monthly payment is a teaser that jumps when the customer doesn't prepay the assumed credit
column4: Every lender product row carries its full Reg Z payment schedule. Where a product assumes a voluntary prepayment or re-amortizes, READ_BACK speaks every scheduled step ("<pay_1> until month <n>, then <pay_2>") with the no-prepayment payment as the payment owed, and the R150 affordability row is tested against the highest step. Products whose payment depends on a tax credit the customer can't be shown to receive are excluded from on-call close.
column5: A fragment lint that refuses any payment key without its schedule-step index.

column3: Financing terms read back before the lender's credit decision, so the commit is gated on an assumed credit tier
column5: State explicitly that a financed COMMIT needs lender_verified rate, term and payment (cash-only commit or a written proposal otherwise), and ban "as low as" fragments from READ_BACK.

column3: Interconnecting forces a rate-plan switch, so savings are computed against a tariff the customer won't be on after install
column4: The calculator computes two bills on verified interval data: the baseline on the current schedule, and the post-solar bill on a policy-table interconnection_tariff row (the mandated rate per utility and program). Savings = baseline minus post-solar. READ_BACK must state the rate change. If several eligible rates are possible, use the least favorable one or give no figure.

column3: Community Choice Aggregator customers: generation rates and export credits are set by the CCA, not the utility tariff the calculator uses
column4: Add a generation_provider slot, written only by the utility API or bill extractor. Key calculator rows by (delivery utility, generation provider, schedule), and add CCA rate/export/cash-out rows watched by the tariff-filing monitor. An unknown provider or missing row means no figure and a written proposal.

column3: Discount-rate households (CARE/FERA, medical baseline) get savings computed at full price, overstating benefit for the poorest customers
column5: A bill-reconciliation gate: the calculator must reproduce the customer's actual billed amounts for the authorized months within tolerance, else no figure. This also catches A3, A4 and A6 classes. Also make discount-program households a Tier A audit stratum.

column3: The savings baseline includes charges solar can't offset (fixed charges, minimum bills, non-bypassable charges)
column5: A build check that a tariff row can't be cited unless it has its fixed, minimum-bill and non-bypassable fields, plus a required READ_BACK "residual utility bill about <x>/month" key.

column3: Production is self-reported: savings need modeled kWh from roof azimuth, tilt and shading that a phone call can't verify
column5: Name a modeled_production provenance class (pinned irradiance model over aerial/LIDAR geometry) that the claims lint requires for every savings or payback fill.

column3: Lifetime savings and payback omit known future costs: inverter replacement, remove-and-reinstall for a reroof, insurance and property tax
column4: Ban lifetime-savings and payback keys from phone fragments: only year-one savings on the call, multi-year figures only in the written proposal. Any multi-year figure must subtract policy-table expected_cost rows keyed on equipment type versus term (inverter replacement), remaining roof life versus term (detach-and-reset) and jurisdiction (insurance and property tax). A suitability row sends any roof whose remaining life is shorter than the term to ROOF_FIRST.

column3: Quote validity across WAITING_FOR_SIGNATURE: the price table changes between the spoken read-back and a signature days later
column5: A quote_valid_until key spoken in READ_BACK and printed in the envelope, plus a model-checked WAITING_FOR_SIGNATURE->EXPIRED edge. Also state that R140's effective-window refusal does not apply when re-deriving values for a sent envelope's frozen quote hash.

column3: The verified usage history isn't the household's future load: new owners, prior occupants, planned EVs and heat pumps
column5: Read service_start_date from the utility API. With fewer than 12 months under the current account holder, give no figure on the call, only a written proposal after the survey. A savings fragment given after a load_change mention must say it is "based on your past usage, not including <load_change>".

column3: Interpreters speak in the first person, so an interpreted "yes, I agree" passes the COMMIT gate while the owner never heard the read-back
column5: An interpreting lexicon ("I'm translating", "let me tell her") and an audio language-ID on near-end segments that set negotiation_language=mixed, so the call gets no English close and goes to an in-language human with a professional interpreter.

column3: Cross-lingual false friends in one-word polar answers (Polish/Czech "no" = yeah, Greek "ne" = yes, Spanish "ya" = enough)
column5: A false-friend particle table (Polish/Czech "no", Greek "ne", Spanish "ya") that feeds the mixed counter, plus a Tier A L1 false-friend red-team stratum.

column3: Opt-out spoken in the caller's other language ("ya no me llamen", "huwag na kayong tumawag") missed by an English lexicon and English-trained Needle
column4: Run an audio spoken-language-ID on every near-end segment. Any non-English or low-confidence turn gets a multilingual ASR second pass checked against a stop/revocation lexicon in the service area's top languages, both live and in the post-call sweep. Any non-English turn the system can't resolve sets suppress-pending (no redial of any kind) until a human reviews the audio. Add a Tier A foreign-language revocation red-team stratum.
column5: Count a mid-call bilingual handoff after a non-English turn as a possible revocation until the receiving human or build confirms otherwise.

column3: Captioned-telephone (IP CTS) users answer seconds-late, error-filled captions in their own voice, so no relay is detected
column5: A CAPTION_MODE profile, triggered by mentions of captions or a caption phone or by a DTMF key: long answer windows, one question in flight, numbers also sent by SMS, and no same-call close.

column3: Speak up / slow down / say that again has no event, and pre-rendered fixed-rate audio can't comply, so hard-of-hearing callers bluff
column5: repair_request kind ∈ {rate, volume} switches to a pre-rendered, round-trip-checked ACCESSIBLE_AUDIO profile (about 0.75x, louder, shorter chunks). A second such repair means no same-call close and a human consult with extra time.

column3: Response-order (recency) effects and echolalia make the deterministic closed binary re-ask hand the last-spoken option to cognitively loaded callers
column5: Lint so that every closed re-ask ends on the safe option ("..., or not?") and the commit phrase is never the final words of its prompt. A commit-turn answer that echoes the prompt's final words doesn't count and adds to the confused counter.

column3: The owner is under a court conservatorship or guardianship (or has a POA agent), which is invisible to the lead record, the identity challenge and the call
column4: Before the envelope, run a court-records (probate conservatorship/guardianship index) search through a vendor for every record owner; a hit suppresses sales and routes to human review. Add an authority_claim(POA|conservator|guardian) GLOBAL subtype with a lexicon: no pitch and no close, routed to an AUTHORITY_REVIEW human path that verifies the instrument. The agent never resumes selling to the principal on that call.

column3: Age-dependent cancellation rights (California: 5 business days for buyers 65+) need the caller's age, which the design has no lawful slot for
column5: Make R148's owner-only confirmation call universal (or key it to non-age signals), and lint that no fragment or contract template states a shorter window than the max-across-profiles policy row.

column3: Low-literacy signers: terms that exist only in the written e-sign document (arbitration, class waiver, assignment, credit-pull authorization) never appear in READ_BACK
column4: Give every clause of the e-sign template a policy-table key tagged material or not. A build invariant requires every material key (arbitration and opt-out, class waiver, assignment plus the FTC Holder Rule notice, credit-pull authorization, data sharing) to have a plain-language READ_BACK fragment. A template with an untagged clause, or a mismatch between the template version and the READ_BACK version, fails the release. The mailed summary repeats these clauses.

column3: I want my son to hear this first (a request to involve a trusted support person) has no event, so the agent proceeds alone or books a consult without them
column5: A SUPPORT_PERSON path: a fixed fragment that honours the request, then a human consult booked at a time she names with support_person_expected set. The son gets the NEW_PARTY disclosure, no AI close is allowed, and the son is contacted only on her written opt-in.

column3: Privacy-rights requests spoken mid-call ("delete my info", "don't sell my data", "what do you have on me?") have no event, so they get filed as DNC or out_of_scope and never start the 45-day clock
column4: Add a GLOBAL privacy_request(kind: delete, know, correct, opt_out_sale_share, limit_sensitive) event, detected by lexicon plus Needle, that co-fires with DNC and never replaces it. It plays a fixed acknowledgement fragment. Its outbox effect opens a DSAR ticket stamped with the statutory due date and sends written confirmation with submission instructions. Deletion then spares only the TSR WORM set, legal_hold and a hashed-number suppression entry. Extend the post-call sweep to privacy phrasings and add a Tier A red-team stratum.
column5: Add an SLA alarm on DSAR tickets nearing day 45.

column3: Right-to-know/access requests: the design cannot assemble the "specific pieces" and inferences it holds on a person, and cannot verify the requester to the required standard
column4: Build a subject-artifact registry. Every written artifact carries a session id, and only the DSAR service can resolve number/lead → sessions → manifest (lead record, slots with provenance, outcome, reason codes, flags, audit labels, transcripts, derived paraphrases) through a keyed surrogate map. A request for specific pieces needs OTP to the verified number, a code mailed to the property of record and a signed declaration, and falls back to a categories response if verification fails. A release check fails any artifact type that is not registered.
column5: Disclose inferences only as plain-language reason codes, never raw model scores.

column3: California Delete Act DROP: lead vendors (registered data brokers) must purge consumers every 45 days, which erases the consent proof the pre-dial gate relies on and keeps feeding DROP-deleted people into purchased lead files
column5: Escrow the consent artifact into the seller's WORM store at lead intake, and make vendors forward DROP processing notices into the R115 bus as suppressions.

column3: Algorithmic disgorgement: one tainted data source forces the FTC-ordered destruction of every Needle release, because each release is trained on "the union of all data" with no per-source unlearning
column4: Give each release a source-lineage manifest (per-source content hashes plus a legal-basis/purpose record), and have the build reject any source without one. Train and certify a standing "clean-room" Needle on synthetic plus consented on-policy data only, as the disgorgement fallback. Require written legal review before any legacy seed source is used for AI training.
column5: Make per-source ablation retrains a periodic drill, so the recertification time is known.

column3: Indefinite retention by design: "real data never replaced", union retraining, bit-identical replay and golden canaries make every call's personal data permanent, which violates CCPA's purpose and retention limits
column5: Publish a per-category retention schedule. Make the real-data training pool a rolling window, age out short NOT_SUITABLE and no-sale calls sooner, and recount rule-of-three after deletions.

column3: Subprocessor chain: the big-model API (live stand-in classifier during build), the ASR vendor, labeling crowd, e-sign and SMS vendors that reserve rights to use call data become "third parties", turning each data flow into an undisclosed sale or sharing and a third-party wiretap
column5: Put a vendor/subprocessor register (service-provider contract, no own use, zero retention, flow-down approval) into the certified bundle hash. Require self-hosted ASR in all-party-consent states, and name "service providers, including AI services" in the recording notice.

column3: Cross-border data: offshore labeling, red-team crowd work and model vendors give "countries of concern" access to bulk U.S. voice and financial data under the DOJ Data Security Program
column5: Make "vetted" explicit as a Part 202 covered-person screen (ownership, location, employment). Keep processing US-only, and give external red-team crowds only synthetic data.

column3: Arranging solar loans makes the seller a GLBA "financial institution", which brings privacy-notice, opt-out, Safeguards Rule and 30-day FTC breach-notice duties that the compliance list never mentions
column4: Add a GLBA row to the regulation profile. The initial privacy notice goes in the e-sign packet and the outbox. A build invariant on the lead-gen/partner handoff effect blocks NPI sharing with nonaffiliated parties unless there is an opt-out or a 313.13 service-provider or joint-marketing contract. Stand up a 16 CFR 314 Safeguards program, keep only lender reference tokens in replay stores, and add an incident runbook with FTC notice within 30 days for 500 or more consumers.

column3: Breach scoping is impossible: no person-to-artifact data map across transcripts, PII surrogates, synthetic derivatives, audit labels, replay stores and weights, so the company cannot name the affected people or data elements within statutory deadlines
column4: Reuse the A2 subject-artifact registry, tagged with data-element classes and jurisdiction from the validated address, so a breach query returns affected residents per state. Keep the surrogate-to-real map in a separate KMS-protected vault, never co-located with training data. Re-scrub every big-model paraphrase and reject outputs with address or loan patterns. Run a yearly tabletop drill against the 30-day statutes.

column3: No CCPA notice at collection in the PREAMBLE, while lead-gen mode silently sells the call's personal data and inferences to partner installers
column4: Add a CCPA profile row: a short oral notice-at-collection segment (categories, purposes including AI training, sold/shared yes or no, retention, link) with a lint against the 7012 element list, plus an outbox SMS with the full notice. Add a GLOBAL opt_out_sale_share event. A build invariant blocks any partner handoff unless the notice segment is playout-marked and no opt-out is set, or the partner is contracted as a service provider.
column5: Keep the oral segment short and chunked under R165's preamble timing limits.

column3: Industry traceback: claiming A-level STIR/SHAKEN makes the seller an originating provider with 24-hour traceback, KYC and Robocall Mitigation Database duties the design never models
column5: Store SIP Call-ID and SHAKEN origid in the CDR at dial permit, staff a traceback responder with a 4-hour internal SLA, and keep sales trunks separate from service lines.

column3: Determinism hands plaintiffs class certification: one compiled script and bit-identical replay turn any single defect into a common question for every call
column5: A defect-recall procedure (quarantine bundle, list affected sessions by hash, suppress and send cure notices) and a volume cap on each new bundle until its first audit window closes.

column3: The written harm budget is discoverable proof of knowing violations: 1e-5 Tier A "accepted harm", open items and red-team logs make violations willful
column5: Present the figure as "maximum undetected rate, target zero", keep a remediation record for every detected Tier A event, and give every open item an owner, deadline and interim control.

column3: Algorithmic disgorgement: a regulator orders destruction of every model trained on unlawfully obtained call data, and "union of all data, never replaced" leaves nothing that can be saved
column4: Add a training-data lineage ledger (every item, real or synthetic, carries source id, consent-artifact id and parent seed hashes; every release manifest lists its item-hash set), a per-release taint drill that drops one source plus its transitive closure, retrains and replays gold sets within a set time, and a standby clean-room Needle trained only on first-party consented on-policy calls, with certification evidence kept only from those calls.

column3: Party-specific consent orders, AVCs and telemarketing bans bind the seller, its lead vendors and anyone "in active concert", but the regulation profile is keyed only by jurisdiction
column4: Add party-scoped obligation_order rows (seller, vendor, principal, successor) whose terms compile into pre-dial predicates, lints and retention rules under most-restrictive-wins; make the release pipeline require a monitor's signing key whenever an active order demands pre-approval; screen vendors and principals against FTC/AG orders at onboarding and weekly, check each lead's source id at dial, and fail closed on age-limited orders when record-sourced DOB is missing.

column3: Consent the gate checks today cannot be proved in court years later: the burden is on the caller, limitation periods outlast vendor-held consent evidence
column5: Copy the full evidence package (rendered form, disclosure text hash, phone as entered, IP, user agent, session replay) into seller WORM at ingestion, reject pointer-only consent at the gate, and store the consent-artifact hash on each CDR.
